# Implementation Plan

## Overview

This implementation plan adds PostgreSQL 18.2 as a third database backend alongside MySQL and SQLite, following the existing repository pattern. Tasks are organized to follow the same pipeline as MySQL: Atlas HCL → Atlas migrations → Docker Compose (DB + migrations) → schema extraction from running DB → sqlc code generation → repositories → DI integration → testing → documentation.

**Key Insight**: Schema files for sqlc (`tools/sqlc/schemas/*.sql`) are auto-generated by extracting from a running database (via `make extract-sqlc-schema-*`), NOT manually written. The PostgreSQL pipeline must follow the same approach: start PostgreSQL in Docker, apply Atlas migrations, then extract schemas via `pg_dump`.

**📘 Implementation References**:
- [Database Schema Changes Guide](../../../docs/guidelines/database-schema-changes.md) - Complete workflow for schema modifications
- [Database Quick Reference](../../../docs/guidelines/database-quick-reference.md) - Command cheat sheet and data type mappings
- See design.md and research.md for architectural decisions and technology research

**Total Estimated Effort**: 5-7 days (based on gap analysis)

**📘 Reference**: See [Database Quick Reference - Data Type Mapping](../../../docs/guidelines/database-quick-reference.md#-data-type-mapping) for MySQL→PostgreSQL conversion table.

  - Configure src: file://schemas/watch.hcl (reuse existing HCL — Atlas HCL is database-agnostic)
  - Set migration dir: file://migrations/postgresql_watch
  - Configure dev database: docker://postgres/18/watch
  - Add similar environments for keygen and sign databases

- [ ] 2.2 (P) Add PostgreSQL admin environments to Atlas configuration

- [ ] 2.3 (P) Generate initial PostgreSQL migrations from HCL

**📘 Reference**: Follow [Database Schema Changes Guide - Scenario 1](../../../docs/guidelines/database-schema-changes.md#scenario-1-adding-a-new-column) for complete schema extraction and sqlc workflow.

  - For sign schema: exclude seed and musig2_nonces tables (same as MySQL)

  - _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2, 2.3_

- [ ] 4.3 Add PostgreSQL schema extraction targets to Makefile

### Phase 4: Connection Management

- [ ] 5. Implement PostgreSQL database connection
- [ ] 5.1 (P) Create PostgreSQL connection factory
  - Create pkg/db/postgresql/connection.go package
  - Implement NewPostgreSQL(conf *config.PostgreSQL) (*sql.DB, error)
  - Use pgx driver: import _ "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib"
  - Build connection string: postgres://user:pass@host:port/dbname?sslmode=mode
  - Configure connection pool: SetMaxOpenConns(25), SetMaxIdleConns(5)
  - Set connection lifetime: SetConnMaxLifetime(5min), SetConnMaxIdleTime(1min)
  - Verify connection with Ping() before returning
  - Wrap errors with descriptive context (host, port, database)
  - _Requirements: 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5_

- [ ] 5.2 (P) Add PostgreSQL client to DI container
  - Add NewPostgreSQLClient() method to pkg DI container
  - Initialize connection using postgresql.NewPostgreSQL()
  - Cache connection in container (singleton pattern)
  - Panic with descriptive error if connection fails during initialization
  - _Requirements: 4.1, 4.2_

## Task Dependencies

**Critical Pipeline (mirrors existing MySQL workflow):**
```
Atlas HCL schemas (already exist)
    │
    ├─ 2.1, 2.2 Atlas PostgreSQL config
    │     │
    │     └─ 2.3 Generate PostgreSQL migrations from HCL
    │           │
    │           ├─ 3.1, 3.2 Docker Compose PostgreSQL service + init scripts
    │           │     │
    │           │     └─ 3.3 Docker Compose migration services
    │           │           │
    │           │           └─ 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 Schema dump & extraction targets
    │           │                 │
    │           │                 └─ 4.5 Run extraction pipeline
    │           │                       │
    │           │                       └─ 4.4 sqlc config → sqlc generate
    │           │                             │
    │           │                             └─ 6.x, 7.x Repositories
    │           │                                   │
    │           │                                   └─ 8.1, 8.2 DI integration
    │           │
    │           └─ 3.4 Atlas version upgrade (parallel)
    │
    └─ 1.1, 1.2 Config support (parallel, no dependency on pipeline)
```

**Sequential Dependencies:**
- 2.1, 2.2 → 2.3 (Atlas config before migration generation)
- 2.3 → 3.3 (migrations must exist before Docker migration services)
- 3.1, 3.2 → 3.3 (PostgreSQL service + init before migration services)
- 3.3 → 4.5 (migrations applied before schema extraction)
- 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 → 4.5 (dump/extract targets before running pipeline)
- 4.4 → 4.5 (sqlc config before generation)
- 4.5 → 6.x, 7.x (sqlcgen package before repositories)
- 6.x, 7.x → 8.1, 8.2 (repositories before DI wiring)
- 5.1 → 5.2 (connection factory before DI client)
- All implementation → Testing (9, 10, 11, 12)
- All testing → Documentation (13)

**Parallel Opportunities (marked with P):**
- Configuration tasks (1.1, 1.2) — independent of entire pipeline
- Atlas config tasks (2.1, 2.2) — no file conflicts
- Docker tasks (3.1, 3.2, 3.4) — separate files
- Makefile tasks (4.6, 4.7) — can be done after 4.4
- Connection tasks (5.1, 5.2) — independent of schema pipeline
- Watch repositories (6.1-6.4) — separate files
- Cold repositories (7.1-7.3) — separate files
- Test files (9.1, 10.1-10.3, 11.2) — isolated test suites
- Documentation (13.1-13.4) — separate markdown files
